entries.title: Calendar save/load oracle re-ran randomized engine startup after loading
entries.first_observed: The second temperate seed in the first complete M21 exact-twin matrix failed the calendar save/load comparison.
entries.impact: A seed-dependent qualification failure could incorrectly classify correct restored engine state as divergent and prevented G21 acceptance.
entries.root_cause: The post-load comparison called StartupEngines again; that mutating initialization path can consume introduction randomness instead of reading the state restored from the save.

diagnostics.review_note: The accepted M14-G21 implementation has zero nonclosed V2 defects or divergences. V2-DEF-0001 records and closes the seed-dependent M21 calendar-oracle defect found by the complete matrix. ChooChoo, SimpleAI, and malformed Lufthansa packages retain their truthful rejection dispositions; ShipAI's M14 healthy-inactive result remains supplemented by M18 scenario-specific active evidence. G20 publishes external-AI choices as stochastic replicates, and G21 deliberately claims only the finite ten-package NewGRF compatibility set. Planned M22-M23 requirements are not defects merely because their gates have not run.
